title: Temperature-Linked Phantom Drain Trend
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:vehicle parked="true"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats earliest(battery_pct) as start_pct, latest(battery_pct) as end_pct, avg(outside_temp_c) as avg_temp by vin _time
| eval loss_pct=start_pct-end_pct
| where loss_pct>3
| sort - loss_pct
description: Quantifies parked battery loss by day so you can see whether cold snaps, heat, or background features are driving the famous EV phantom drain problem.
value: Battery drain feels mysterious until it is grouped by weather and parked time; a simple daily loss table reveals whether the culprit is the environment or the vehicle settings.
implementation: Ingest parked-state battery percentage and ambient temperature; schedule daily and trend drain on days above your normal loss rate.
visualization: Daily chart of parked battery loss with average outside temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how much battery your parked car is quietly losing each day, especially when weather makes it worse.
